name: Ryoujoku Konbini ~Tenchou Yamete Kudasai~
original_name: 凌辱コンビニ ～店長やめて下さい～
source:
Main character is a convenience store manager. The staff is gentle here, and customers evaluation is high. One day a part-time worker makes a mistake and undergoes sexual harassment punishment from the manager. But with every following day his actions become bolder.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-september-2002-masaru.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角經營著一家便利商店。店員待客溫和，顧客評價一直不錯。一天，一名兼職店員犯了錯，店長便以懲罰為名，對她實施性騷擾。從那以後，他的舉動一天比一天大膽。
